name: Affine KSampler (scheduled pattern-masked scale and bias on the noisy latent)
plain: Splits sampling into chunks of core KSamplerAdvanced (or guider.sample for the custom version) and, every affine_interval steps where a per-step schedule weight is above zero, multiplies the noisy latent by a scale and adds a bias inside a procedural or content mask (Perlin, checker, Bayer, Worley, cross-hatch, detail or edge regions, an external mask and more). The schedule rises and falls between start and end fractions of the run with an easing curve; WASAffineScheduleOptions builds it. Surprises: every chunk is a separate sampler call with the same noise seed, so multistep history resets at each boundary and ancestral samplers can repeat their step noise; the Ultimate Latent node does the same with optional tiling (tiling not read in detail).
math:
Symbols: x noisy latent; m mask in [0,1]; t_i schedule weight at step i; S max_scale; B max_bias.
t_i: 0 before start, eased rise to 1 at start+bias·(end−start), eased fall to 0 at end (offsets and exponent applied).
at boundary i with t_i>0: s = 1+(S−1)t_i, b = B·t_i; x ← x·((1−m)+m·s) + b·m; then continue sampling.

props.params: affine_interval, max_scale, max_bias, pattern, affine_seed, affine_seed_increment, affine_schedule (start 0.2, end 0.8, bias 0.5, exponent 1, curve easeInOutSine), merge_inactive_steps, optional external_mask, options, noise_options
